καγω.def: from καί (G2532) and ἐγώ (G1473); so also the dative case κἀμοί, and accusative case κἀμέ and (or also, even, etc.) I, (to) me. KJV: (and, even, even so, so) I (also, in like wise), both me, me also.

καθα.def: from κατά (G2596) and the neuter plural of ὅς (G3739); according to which things, i.e. just as. KJV: as.

καθαιρεσισ.def: from καθαιρέω (G2507); demolition; figuratively, extinction. KJV: destruction, pulling down.

καθαιρεω.def: from κατά (G2596) and αἱρέομαι (G138) (including its alternate); to lower (or with violence) demolish (literally or figuratively). KJV: cast (pull, put, take) down, destroy.

καθαιρω.def: from καθαρός (G2513); to cleanse, i.e. (specially) to prune; figuratively, to expiate. KJV: purge.

καθαπερ.def: from καθά (G2505) and περ (G4007); exactly as. KJV: (even, as well) as.

καθαπτω.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἅπτομαι (G680); to seize upon. KJV: fasten on.

καθαριζω.def: from καθαρός (G2513); to cleanse (literally or figuratively). KJV: (make) clean(-se), purge, purify.

καθαρισμοσ.def: from καθαρίζω (G2511); a washing off, i.e. (ceremonially) ablution, (morally) expiation. KJV: cleansing, + purge, purification(-fying).

καθαροσ.def: of uncertain affinity; clean (literally or figuratively). KJV: clean, clear, pure.

καθεδρα.def: from κατά (G2596) and the same as ἑδραῖος (G1476); a bench (literally or figuratively). KJV: seat.

καθεζομαι.def: from κατά (G2596) and the base of ἑδραῖος (G1476); to sit down. KJV: sit.

καθεξησ.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἑξῆς (G1836); thereafter, i.e. consecutively; as a noun (by ellipsis of noun) a subsequent person or time. KJV: after(-ward), by (in) order.

καθευδω.def: from κατά (G2596) and εὕδω (to sleep); to lie down to rest, i.e. (by implication) to fall asleep (literally or figuratively). KJV: (be a-)sleep.

καθηγητησ.def: from a compound of κατά (G2596) and ἡγέομαι (G2233); a guide, i.e. (figuratively) a teacher. KJV: master.

καθηκω.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἥκω (G2240); to reach to, i.e. (neuter of present active participle, figuratively as adjective) becoming. KJV: convenient, fit.

καθημαι.def: from κατά (G2596); and ἧμαι (to sit; akin to the base of ἑδραῖος (G1476)); to sit down; figuratively, to remain, reside. KJV: dwell, sit (by, down).

καθημερινοσ.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἡμέρα (G2250); quotidian. KJV: daily.

καθιζω.def: another (active) form for καθέζομαι (G2516); to seat down, i.e. set (figuratively, appoint); intransitively, to sit (down); figuratively, to settle (hover, dwell). KJV: continue, set, sit (down), tarry.

καθιημι.def: from κατά (G2596); and ἵημι (to send); to lower. KJV: let down.

καθιστημι.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἵστημι (G2476); to place down (permanently), i.e. (figuratively) to designate, constitute, convoy. KJV: appoint, be, conduct, make, ordain, set.

καθο.def: from κατά (G2596) and ὅς (G3739); according to which thing, i.e. precisely as, in proportion as. KJV: according to that, (inasmuch) as.

καθολου.def: from κατά (G2596) and ὅλος (G3650); on the whole, i.e. entirely. KJV: at all.

καθοπλιζω.def: from κατά (G2596); and ὁπλίζω (G3695); to equip fully with armor. KJV: arm.

καθοραω.def: from κατά (G2596) and ὁράω (G3708); to behold fully, i.e. (figuratively) distinctly apprehend. KJV: clearly see.

καθοτι.def: from κατά (G2596); and ὅς (G3739) and τὶς (G5100); according to which certain thing, i.e. as far (or inasmuch) as. KJV: (according, forasmuch) as, because (that).

καθωσ.def: from κατά (G2596) and ὡς (G5613); just (or inasmuch) as, that. KJV: according to, (according, even) as, how, when.

και.def: apparently, a primary particle, having a copulative and sometimes also a cumulative force; and, also, even, so then, too, etc.; often used in connection (or composition) with other particles or small words. KJV: and, also, both, but, even, for, if, or, so, that, then, therefore, when, yet.

καιαφασ.def: of Chaldee origin; the dell; Caiaphas (i.e. Cajepha), an Israelite. KJV: Caiaphas.

καιγε.def: from καί (G2532) and γέ (G1065); and at least (or even, indeed). KJV: and, at least.

καιν.def: of Hebrew origin (H7014); Cain, (i.e. Cajin), the son of Adam. KJV: Cain.

καιναν.def: of Hebrew origin (H7018); Cainan (i.e. Kenan), the name of two patriarchs. KJV: Cainan.

καινοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; new (especially in freshness; while νέος (G3501) is properly so with respect to age. KJV: new.

καιπερ.def: from καί (G2532) and περ (G4007); and indeed, i.e. nevertheless or notwithstanding. KJV: and yet, although.

καιροσ.def: of uncertain affinity; an occasion, i.e. set or proper time. KJV: X always, opportunity, (convenient, due) season, (due, short, while) time, a while.

καισαρ.def: of Latin origin; Cæsar, a title of the Roman emperor. KJV: Cæsar.

καισαρεια.def: from Καῖσαρ (G2541); Cæsaria, the name of two places in Palestine. KJV: Cæsarea.

καιτοι.def: from καί (G2532) and τοί (G5104); and yet, i.e. nevertheless. KJV: although.

καιτοιγε.def: from καίτοι (G2543) and γέ (G1065); and yet indeed, i.e. although really. KJV: nevertheless, though.

καιω.def: apparently a primary verb; to set on fire, i.e. kindle or (by implication) consume. KJV: burn, light.

κακει.def: from καί (G2532) and ἐκεῖ (G1563); likewise in that place. KJV: and there, there (thither) also.

κακειθεν.def: from καί (G2532) and ἐκεῖθεν (G1564); likewise from that place (or time). KJV: and afterward (from) (thence), thence also.

κακεινοσ.def: from καί (G2532) and ἐκεῖνος (G1565); likewise that (or those). KJV: and him (other, them), even he, him also, them (also), (and) they.

κακια.def: from κακός (G2556); badness, i.e. (subjectively) depravity, or (actively) malignity, or (passively) trouble. KJV: evil, malice(-iousness), naughtiness, wickedness.

κακοηθεια.def: from a compound of κακός (G2556) and ἦθος (G2239); bad character, i.e. (specially) mischievousness. KJV: malignity.

κακολογεω.def: from a compound of κακός (G2556) and λόγος (G3056); to revile. KJV: curse, speak evil of.

κακοπαθεια.def: from a compound of ἡμιώριον (G2256) and πάθος (G3806); hardship. KJV: suffering affliction.

κακοπαθεω.def: from the same as κακοπάθεια (G2552); to undergo hardship. KJV: be afflicted, endure afflictions (hardness), suffer trouble.

κακοποιεω.def: from κακοποιός (G2555); to be a bad-doer, i.e. (objectively) to injure, or (genitive) to sin. KJV: do(ing) evil.

κακοποιοσ.def: from κακός (G2556) and ποιέω (G4160); a bad-doer; (specially), a criminal. KJV: evil-doer, malefactor.

κακοσ.def: apparently a primary word; worthless (intrinsically, such; whereas πονηρός (G4190) properly refers to effects), i.e. (subjectively) depraved, or (objectively) injurious. KJV: bad, evil, harm, ill, noisome, wicked.

κακουργοσ.def: from κακός (G2556) and the base of ἔργον (G2041); a wrong-doer, i.e. criminal. KJV: evil-doer, malefactor.

κακουχεω.def: from a presumed compound of κακός (G2556) and ἔχω (G2192); to maltreat. KJV: which suffer adversity, torment.

κακοω.def: from κακός (G2556); to injure; figuratively, to exasperate. KJV: make evil affected, entreat evil, harm, hurt, vex.

κακωσ.def: from κακός (G2556); badly (physically or morally). KJV: amiss, diseased, evil, grievously, miserably, sick, sore.

καλαμη.def: feminine of κάλαμος (G2563); a stalk of grain, i.e. (collectively) stubble. KJV: stubble.

καλαμοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; a reed (the plant or its stem, or that of a similar plant); by implication, a pen. KJV: pen, reed.

καλεω.def: akin to the base of κελεύω (G2753); to "call" (properly, aloud, but used in a variety of applications, directly or otherwise). KJV: bid, call (forth), (whose, whose sur-)name (was (called)).

καλλιελαιοσ.def: from the base of καλλίον (G2566) and ἐλαία (G1636); a cultivated olive tree, i.e. a domesticated or improved one. KJV: good olive tree.

καλλιον.def: neuter of the (irregular) comparative of καλός (G2570); (adverbially) better than many. KJV: very well.

καλοδιδασκαλοσ.def: from καλός (G2570) and διδάσκαλος (G1320); a teacher of the right. KJV: teacher of good things.

καλοιλιμενεσ.def: plural of καλός (G2570) and λιμήν (G3040); Good Harbors, i.e. Fairhaven, a bay of Crete. KJV: fair havens.

καλοποιεω.def: from καλός (G2570) and ποιέω (G4160); to do well, i.e. live virtuously. KJV: well doing.

καλοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; properly, beautiful, but chiefly (figuratively) good (literally or morally), i.e. valuable or virtuous (for appearance or use, and thus distinguished from ἀγαθός (G18), which is properly intrinsic). KJV: X better, fair, good(-ly), honest, meet, well, worthy.

καλυμα.def: from καλύπτω (G2572); a cover, i.e. veil. KJV: vail.

καλυπτω.def: akin to κλέπτω (G2813) and κρύπτω (G2928); to cover up (literally or figuratively). KJV: cover, hide.

καλωσ.def: adverb from καλός (G2570); well (usually morally). KJV: (in a) good (place), honestly, + recover, (full) well.

καμηλοσ.def: of Hebrew origin (H1581); a "camel". KJV: camel.

καμινοσ.def: probably from καίω (G2545); a furnace. KJV: furnace.

καμμυω.def: from a compound of κατά (G2596) and the base of μυστήριον (G3466); to shut down, i.e. close the eyes. KJV: close.

καμνω.def: apparently a primary verb; properly, to toil, i.e. (by implication) to tire (figuratively, faint, sicken). KJV: faint, sick, be wearied.

καμπτω.def: apparently a primary verb; to bend. KJV: bow.

καν.def: from καί (G2532) and ἐάν (G1437); and (or even) if. KJV: and (also) if (so much as), if but, at the least, though, yet.

κανα.def: of Hebrew origin (compare H7071); Cana, a place in Palestine. KJV: Cana.

κανανιτησ.def: of Chaldee origin (compare H7067); zealous; Cananites, an epithet. KJV: Canaanite (by mistake for a derivative from Χαναάν (G5477)).

κανδακη.def: of foreign origin; Candacè, an Egyptian queen. KJV: Candace.

κανων.def: from κάνη (a straight reed, i.e. rod); a rule ("canon"), i.e. (figuratively) a standard (of faith and practice); by implication, a boundary, i.e. (figuratively) a sphere (of activity). KJV: line, rule.

καπερναουμ.def: of Hebrew origin (probably H3723 and H5151); Capernaum (i.e. Caphanachum), a place in Palestine. KJV: Capernaum.

καπηλευω.def: from κάπηλος (a huckster); to retail, i.e. (by implication) to adulterate (figuratively). KJV: corrupt.

καπνοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; smoke. KJV: smoke.

καππαδοκια.def: of foreign origin; Cappadocia, a region of Asia Minor. KJV: Cappadocia.

καρδια.def: prolonged from a primary κάρ (Latin cor, "heart"); the heart, i.e. (figuratively) the thoughts or feelings (mind); also (by analogy) the middle. KJV: (+ broken-)heart(-ed).

καρδιογνωστησ.def: from καρδία (G2588) and γινώσκω (G1097); a heart-knower. KJV: which knowest the hearts.

καρποσ.def: probably from the base of ἁρπάζω (G726); fruit (as plucked), literally or figuratively. KJV: fruit.
perhaps for καρπός (G2590); Carpus, probably a Christian. KJV: Carpus.

καρποφορεω.def: from καρποφόρος (G2593); to be fertile (literally or figuratively). KJV: be (bear, bring forth) fruit(-ful).

καρποφοροσ.def: from καρπός (G2590) and φέρω (G5342); fruitbearing (figuratively). KJV: fruitful.

καρτερεω.def: from a derivative of κράτος (G2904) (transposed); to be strong, i.e. (figuratively) steadfast (patient). KJV: endure.

καρφοσ.def: from κάρφω (to wither); a dry twig or straw. KJV: mote.

κατα.def: a primary particle; (prepositionally) down (in place or time), in varied relations (according to the case (genitive, dative or accusative) with which it is joined). KJV: about, according as (to), after, against, (when they were) X alone, among, and, X apart, (even, like) as (concerning, pertaining to touching), X aside, at, before, beyond, by, to the charge of, (charita-)bly, concerning, + covered, (dai-)ly, down, every, (+ far more) exceeding, X more excellent, for, from … to, godly, in(-asmuch, divers, every, -to, respect of), … by, after the manner of, + by any means, beyond (out of) measure, X mightily, more, X natural, of (up-)on (X part), out (of every), over against, (+ your) X own, + particularly, so, through(-oughout, -oughout every), thus, (un-)to(-gether, -ward), X uttermost, where(-by), with.

καταβαινω.def: from κατά (G2596) and the base of βάσις (G939); to descend (literally or figuratively). KJV: come (get, go, step) down, fall (down).

καταβαλλω.def: from κατά (G2596) and βάλλω (G906); to throw down. KJV: cast down, lay.

καταβαρεω.def: from κατά (G2596) and βαρέω (G916); to impose upon. KJV: burden.

καταβασισ.def: from καταβαίνω (G2597); a declivity. KJV: descent.

καταβιβαζω.def: from κατά (G2596) and a derivative of the base of βάσις (G939); to cause to go down, i.e. precipitate. KJV: bring (thrust) down.

καταβολη.def: from καταβάλλω (G2598); a deposition, i.e. founding; figuratively, conception. KJV: conceive, foundation.

καταβραβευω.def: from κατά (G2596) and βραβεύω (G1018) (in its original sense); to award the price against, i.e. (figuratively) to defraud (of salvation). KJV: beguile of reward.

καταγγελευσ.def: from καταγγέλλω (G2605); a proclaimer. KJV: setter forth.

καταγγελλω.def: from κατά (G2596) and the base of ἄγγελος (G32); to proclaim, promulgate. KJV: declare, preach, shew, speak of, teach.

καταγελαω.def: to laugh down, i.e. deride. KJV: laugh to scorn.

καταγινωσκω.def: from κατά (G2596) and γινώσκω (G1097); to note against, i.e. find fault with. KJV: blame, condemn.

καταγνυμι.def: from κατά (G2596) and the base of ῥήγνυμι (G4486); to rend in pieces, i.e. crack apart. KJV: break.

καταγω.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἄγω (G71); to lead down; specially, to moor a vessel. KJV: bring (down, forth), (bring to) land, touch.

καταγωνιζομαι.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἀγωνίζομαι (G75); to struggle against, i.e. (by implication) to overcome. KJV: subdue.

καταδεω.def: from κατά (G2596) and δέω (G1210); to tie down, i.e. bandage (a wound). KJV: bind up.

καταδηλοσ.def: from κατά (G2596) intensive and δῆλος (G1212); manifest. KJV: far more evident.

καταδικαζω.def: from κατά (G2596) and a derivative of δίκη (G1349); to adjudge against, i.e. pronounce guilty. KJV: condemn.

καταδιωκω.def: from κατά (G2596) and διώκω (G1377); to hunt down, i.e. search for. KJV: follow after.

καταδουλοω.def: from κατά (G2596) and δουλόω (G1402); to enslave utterly. KJV: bring into bondage.

καταδυναστευω.def: from κατά (G2596) and a derivative of δυνάστης (G1413); to exercise dominion against, i.e. oppress. KJV: oppress.

καταισχυνω.def: from κατά (G2596) and αἰσχύνομαι (G153); to shame down, i.e. disgrace or (by implication) put to the blush. KJV: confound, dishonour, (be a-, make a-)shame(-d).

κατακαιω.def: from κατά (G2596) and καίω (G2545); to burn down (to the ground), i.e. consume wholly. KJV: burn (up, utterly).

κατακαλυπτω.def: from κατά (G2596) and καλύπτω (G2572); to cover wholly, i.e. veil. KJV: cover, hide.

κατακαυχαομαι.def: from κατά (G2596) and καυχάομαι (G2744); to exult against (i.e. over). KJV: boast (against), glory, rejoice against.

κατακειμαι.def: from κατά (G2596) and κεῖμαι (G2749); to lie down, i.e. (by implication) be sick; specially, to recline at a meal. KJV: keep, lie, sit at meat (down).

κατακλαω.def: from κατά (G2596) and κλάω (G2806); to break down, i.e. divide. KJV: break.

κατακλειω.def: from κατά (G2596) and κλείω (G2808); to shut down (in a dungeon), i.e. incarcerate. KJV: shut up.

κατακληροδοτεω.def: from κατά (G2596) and a derivative of a compound of κλῆρος (G2819) and δίδωμι (G1325); to be a giver of lots to each, i.e. (by implication) to apportion an estate. KJV: divide by lot.

κατακλινω.def: from κατά (G2596) and κλίνω (G2827); to recline down, i.e. (specially) to take a place at table. KJV: (make) sit down (at meat).

κατακλυζω.def: from κατά (G2596) and the base of κλύδων (G2830); to dash (wash) down, i.e. (by implication) to deluge. KJV: overflow.

κατακλυσμοσ.def: from κατακλύζω (G2626); an inundation. KJV: flood.

κατακολουθεω.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἀκολουθέω (G190); to accompany closely. KJV: follow (after).

κατακοπτω.def: from κατά (G2596) and κόπτω (G2875); to chop down, i.e. mangle. KJV: cut.

κατακρημνιζω.def: from κατά (G2596) and a derivative of κρημνός (G2911); to precipitate down. KJV: cast down headlong.

κατακριμα.def: from κατακρίνω (G2632); an adverse sentence (the verdict). KJV: condemnation.

κατακρινω.def: from κατά (G2596) and κρίνω (G2919); to judge against, i.e. sentence. KJV: condemn, damn.

κατακρισισ.def: from κατακρίνω (G2632); sentencing adversely (the act). KJV: condemn(-ation).

κατακυριευω.def: from κατά (G2596) and κυριεύω (G2961); to lord against, i.e. control, subjugate. KJV: exercise dominion over (lordship), be lord over, overcome.

καταλαλεω.def: from κατάλαλος (G2637); to be a traducer, i.e. to slander. KJV: speak against (evil of).

καταλαλια.def: from κατάλαλος (G2637); defamation. KJV: backbiting, evil speaking.

καταλαλοσ.def: from κατά (G2596) and the base of λαλέω (G2980); talkative against, i.e. a slanderer. KJV: backbiter.

καταλαμβανω.def: from κατά (G2596) and λαμβάνω (G2983); to take eagerly, i.e. seize, possess, etc. (literally or figuratively). KJV: apprehend, attain, come upon, comprehend, find, obtain, perceive, (over-)take.

καταλεγω.def: from κατά (G2596) and λέγω (G3004) (in its original meaning); to lay down, i.e. (figuratively) to enrol. KJV: take into the number.

καταλειμμα.def: from καταλείπω (G2641); a remainder, i.e. (by implication) a few. KJV: remnant.

καταλειπω.def: from κατά (G2596) and λείπω (G3007); to leave down, i.e. behind; by implication, to abandon, have remaining. KJV: forsake, leave, reserve.

καταλιθαζω.def: from κατά (G2596) and λιθάζω (G3034); to stone down, i.e. to death. KJV: stone.

καταλλαγη.def: from καταλλάσσω (G2644); exchange (figuratively, adjustment), i.e. restoration to (the divine) favor. KJV: atonement, reconciliation(-ing).

καταλλασσω.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἀλλάσσω (G236); to change mutually, i.e. (figuratively) to compound a difference. KJV: reconcile.

καταλοιποσ.def: from κατά (G2596) and λοιποί (G3062); left down (behind), i.e remaining (plural the rest). KJV: residue.

καταλυμα.def: from καταλύω (G2647); properly, a dissolution (breaking up of a journey), i.e. (by implication) a lodging-place. KJV: guestchamber, inn.

καταλυω.def: from κατά (G2596) and λύω (G3089); to loosen down (disintegrate), i.e. (by implication) to demolish (literally or figuratively); specially (compare κατάλυμα (G2646)) to halt for the night. KJV: destroy, dissolve, be guest, lodge, come to nought, overthrow, throw down.

καταμανθανω.def: from κατά (G2596) and μανθάνω (G3129); to learn thoroughly, i.e. (by implication) to note carefully. KJV: consider.

καταμαρτυρεω.def: from κατά (G2596) and μαρτυρέω (G3140); to testify against. KJV: witness against.

καταμενω.def: from κατά (G2596) and μένω (G3306); to stay fully, i.e. reside. KJV: abide.

καταμονασ.def: from κατά (G2596) and accusative case plural feminine of μόνος (G3441) (with χώρα (G5561) implied); according to sole places, i.e. (adverbially) separately. KJV: alone.

καταναθεμα.def: from κατά (G2596) (intensive) and ἀνάθεμα (G331); an imprecation. KJV: curse.

καταναθεματιζω.def: from κατά (G2596) (intensive) and ἀναθεματίζω (G332); to imprecate. KJV: curse.

καταναλισκω.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἀναλίσκω (G355); to consume utterly. KJV: consume.

καταναρκαω.def: from κατά (G2596) and ναρκάω (to be numb); to grow utterly torpid, i.e. (by implication) slothful (figuratively, expensive). KJV: be burdensome (chargeable).

κατανευω.def: from κατά (G2596) and νεύω (G3506); to nod down (towards), i.e. (by analogy) to make signs to. KJV: beckon.

κατανοεω.def: from κατά (G2596) and νοιέω (G3539); to observe fully. KJV: behold, consider, discover, perceive.

κατανταω.def: from κατά (G2596) and a derivative of ἀντί (G473); to meet against, i.e. arrive at (literally or figuratively). KJV: attain, come.

κατανυξισ.def: from κατανύσσω (G2660); a prickling (sensation, as of the limbs asleep), i.e. (by implication, (perhaps by some confusion with νεύω (G3506) or even with νύξ (G3571))) stupor (lethargy). KJV: slumber.

κατανυσσω.def: from κατά (G2596) and νύσσω (G3572); to pierce thoroughly, i.e. (figuratively) to agitate violently ("sting to the quick"). KJV: prick.

καταξιοω.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἀξιόω (G515); to deem entirely deserving. KJV: (ac-)count worthy.

καταπατεω.def: from κατά (G2596) and πατέω (G3961); to trample down; figuratively, to reject with disdain. KJV: trample, tread (down, underfoot).

καταπαυσισ.def: from καταπαύω (G2664); reposing down, i.e. (by Hebraism) abode. KJV: rest.

καταπαυω.def: from κατά (G2596) and παύω (G3973); to settle down, i.e. (literally) to colonize, or (figuratively) to (cause to) desist. KJV: cease, (give) rest(-rain).

καταπετασμα.def: from a compound of κατά (G2596) and a congener of πέτομαι (G4072); something spread thoroughly, i.e. (specially) the door screen (to the Most Holy Place) in the Jewish Temple. KJV: vail.

καταπινω.def: from κατά (G2596) and πίνω (G4095); to drink down, i.e. gulp entire (literally or figuratively). KJV: devour, drown, swallow (up).

καταπιπτω.def: from κατά (G2596) and πίπτω (G4098); to fall down. KJV: fall (down).

καταπλεω.def: from κατά (G2596) and πλέω (G4126); to sail down upon a place, i.e. to land at. KJV: arrive.

καταπονεω.def: from κατά (G2596) and a derivative of πόνος (G4192); to labor down, i.e. wear with toil (figuratively, harass). KJV: oppress, vex.

καταποντιζω.def: from κατά (G2596) and a derivative of the same as Πόντος (G4195); to plunge down, i.e. submerge. KJV: drown, sink.

καταρα.def: from κατά (G2596) (intensive) and ἀρά (G685); imprecation, execration. KJV: curse(-d, ing).

καταραομαι.def: middle voice from κατάρα (G2671); to execrate; by analogy, to doom. KJV: curse.

καταργεω.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἀργέω (G691); to be (render) entirely idle (useless), literally or figuratively. KJV: abolish, cease, cumber, deliver, destroy, do away, become (make) of no (none, without) effect, fail, loose, bring (come) to nought, put away (down), vanish away, make void.

καταριθμεω.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἀριθμέω (G705); to reckon among. KJV: number with.

καταρτιζω.def: from κατά (G2596) and a derivative of ἄρτιος (G739); to complete thoroughly, i.e. repair (literally or figuratively) or adjust. KJV: fit, frame, mend, (make) perfect(-ly join together), prepare, restore.

καταρτισισ.def: from καταρτίζω (G2675); thorough equipment (subjectively). KJV: perfection.

καταρτισμοσ.def: from καταρτίζω (G2675); complete furnishing (objectively). KJV: perfecting.

κατασειω.def: from κατά (G2596) and σείω (G4579); to sway downward, i.e. make a signal. KJV: beckon.

κατασκαπτω.def: from κατά (G2596) and σκάπτω (G4626); to undermine, i.e. (by implication) destroy. KJV: dig down, ruin.

κατασκευαζω.def: from κατά (G2596) and a derivative of σκεῦος (G4632); to prepare thoroughly (properly, by external equipment; whereas ἑτοιμάζω (G2090) refers rather to internal fitness); by implication, to construct, create. KJV: build, make, ordain, prepare.

κατασκηνοω.def: from κατά (G2596) and σκηνόω (G4637); to camp down, i.e. haunt; figuratively, to remain. KJV: lodge, rest.

κατασκηνωσισ.def: from κατασκηνόω (G2681); an encamping, i.e. (figuratively) a perch. KJV: nest.

κατασκιαζω.def: from κατά (G2596) and a derivative of σκιά (G4639); to overshade, i.e. cover. KJV: shadow.

κατασκοπεω.def: from κατάσκοπος (G2685); to be a sentinel, i.e. to inspect insidiously. KJV: spy out.

κατασκοποσ.def: from κατά (G2596) (intensive) and σκοπός (G4649) (in the sense of a watcher); a reconnoiterer. KJV: spy.

κατασοφιζομαι.def: middle voice from κατά (G2596) and σοφίζω (G4679); to be crafty against, i.e. circumvent. KJV: deal subtilly with.

καταστελλω.def: from κατά (G2596) and στέλλω (G4724); to put down, i.e. quell. KJV: appease, quiet.

καταστημα.def: from καθίστημι (G2525); properly, a position or condition, i.e. (subjectively) demeanor. KJV: behaviour.

καταστολη.def: from καταστέλλω (G2687); a deposit, i.e. (specially) costume. KJV: apparel.

καταστρεφω.def: from κατά (G2596) and στρέφω (G4762); to turn upside down, i.e. upset. KJV: overthrow.

καταστρηνιαω.def: from κατά (G2596) and στρηνιάω (G4763); to become voluptuous against. KJV: begin to wax wanton against.

καταστροφη.def: from καταστρέφω (G2690); an overturn ("catastrophe"), i.e. demolition; figuratively, apostasy. KJV: overthrow, subverting.

καταστρωννυμι.def: from κατά (G2596) and στρώννυμι (G4766); to strew down, i.e. (by implication) to prostrate (slay). KJV: overthrow.

κατασυρω.def: from κατά (G2596) and σύρω (G4951); to drag down, i.e. arrest judicially. KJV: hale.

κατασφαττω.def: from κατά (G2596) and σφάζω (G4969); to kill down, i.e. slaughter. KJV: slay.

κατασφραγιζω.def: from κατά (G2596) and σφραγίζω (G4972); to seal closely. KJV: seal.

κατασχεσισ.def: from κατέχω (G2722); a holding down, i.e. occupancy. KJV: possession.

κατατιθημι.def: from κατά (G2596) and τίθημι (G5087); to place down, i.e. deposit (literally or figuratively). KJV: do, lay, shew.

κατατομη.def: from a compound of κατά (G2596) and τέμνω (to cut); a cutting down (off), i.e. mutilation (ironically). KJV: concision.

κατατοξευω.def: from κατά (G2596) and a derivative of τόξον (G5115); to shoot down with an arrow or other missile. KJV: thrust through.

κατατρεχω.def: from κατά (G2596) and τρέχω (G5143); to run down, i.e. hasten from a tower. KJV: run down.

καταφερω.def: from κατά (G2596) and φέρω (G5342) (including its alternate); to bear down, i.e. (figuratively) overcome (with drowsiness); specially, to cast a vote. KJV: fall, give, sink down.

καταφευγω.def: from κατά (G2596) and φεύγω (G5343); to flee down (away). KJV: flee.

καταφθειρω.def: from κατά (G2596) and φθείρω (G5351); to spoil entirely, i.e. (literally) to destroy; or (figuratively) to deprave;. KJV: corrupt, utterly perish.

καταφιλεω.def: from 2596 and 5368; to kiss earnestly. KJV: kiss.

καταφρονεω.def: from κατά (G2596) and φρονέω (G5426); to think against, i.e. disesteem. KJV: despise.

καταφροντησ.def: from καταφρονέω (G2706); a contemner. KJV: despiser.

καταχεω.def: from κατά (G2596) and cheo (to pour); to pour down (out). KJV: pour.

καταχθονιοσ.def: from κατά (G2596) and χθών (the ground); subterranean, i.e. infernal (belonging to the world of departed spirits). KJV: under the earth.

καταχραομαι.def: from κατά (G2596) and χράομαι (G5530); to overuse, i.e. misuse. KJV: abuse.

καταψυχω.def: from κατά (G2596) and ψύχω (G5594); to cool down (off), i.e. refresh. KJV: cool.

κατειδωλοσ.def: from κατά (G2596) (intensively) and εἴδωλον (G1497); utterly idolatrous. KJV: wholly given to idolatry.

κατεναντι.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἔναντι (G1725); directly opposite. KJV: before, over against.

κατενωπιον.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἐνώπιον (G1799); directly in front of. KJV: before (the presence of), in the sight of.

κατεξουσιαζω.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἐξουσιάζω (G1850); to have (wield) full privilege over. KJV: exercise authority.

κατεργαζομαι.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἐργάζομαι (G2038); to work fully, i.e. accomplish; by implication, to finish, fashion. KJV: cause, to (deed), perform, work (out).

κατερχομαι.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἔρχομαι (G2064) (including its alternate); to come (or go) down (literally or figuratively). KJV: come (down), depart, descend, go down, land.

κατεσθιω.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἐσθίω (G2068) (including its alternate); to eat down, i.e. devour (literally or figuratively). KJV: devour.

κατευθυνω.def: from κατά (G2596) and εὐθύνω (G2116); to straighten fully, i.e. (figuratively) direct. KJV: guide, direct.

κατεφιστημι.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἐφίστημι (G2186); to stand over against, i.e. rush upon (assault). KJV: make insurrection against.

κατεχω.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἔχω (G2192); to hold down (fast), in various applications (literally or figuratively). KJV: have, hold (fast), keep (in memory), let, X make toward, possess, retain, seize on, stay, take, withhold.

κατηγορεω.def: from κατήγορος (G2725); to be a plaintiff, i.e. to charge with some offence. KJV: accuse, object.

κατηγορια.def: from κατήγορος (G2725); a complaint ("category"), i.e. criminal charge. KJV: accusation (X -ed).

κατηγοροσ.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἀγορά (G58); against one in the assembly, i.e. a complainant at law; specially, Satan. KJV: accuser.

κατηφεια.def: from a compound of κατά (G2596) and perhaps a derivative of the base of φαίνω (G5316) (meaning downcast in look); demureness, i.e. (by implication) sadness. KJV: heaviness.

κατηχεω.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἦχος (G2279); to sound down into the ears, i.e. (by implication) to indoctrinate ("catechize") or (genitive case) to apprise of. KJV: inform, instruct, teach.

κατιοω.def: from κατά (G2596) and a derivative of ἰός (G2447); to rust down, i.e. corrode. KJV: canker.

κατισχυω.def: from κατά (G2596) and ἰσχύω (G2480); to overpower. KJV: prevail (against).

κατοικεω.def: from κατά (G2596) and οἰκέω (G3611); to house permanently, i.e. reside (literally or figuratively). KJV: dwell(-er), inhabitant(-ter).

κατοικησισ.def: from κατοικέω (G2730); residence (properly, the act; but by implication, concretely, the mansion). KJV: dwelling.

κατοικητηριον.def: from a derivative of κατοικέω (G2730); a dwelling-place. KJV: habitation.

κατοικια.def: residence (properly, the condition; but by implication, the abode itself). KJV: habitation.

κατοπτριζομαι.def: middle voice from a compound of κατά (G2596) and a derivative of ὀπτάνομαι (G3700) (compare ἔσοπτρον (G2072)); to mirror oneself, i.e. to see reflected (figuratively). KJV: behold as in a glass.

κατορθωμα.def: from a compound of κατά (G2596) and a derivative of ὀρθός (G3717) (compare διόρθωσις (G1357)); something made fully upright, i.e. (figuratively) rectification (specially, good public administration). KJV: very worthy deed.

κατω.def: (compare κατώτερος (G2737)); adverb from κατά (G2596); downwards. KJV: beneath, bottom, down, under.

κατωτεροσ.def: comparative from κάτω (G2736); inferior (locally, of Hades). KJV: lower.

καυμα.def: from καίω (G2545); properly, a burn (concretely), but used (abstractly) of a glow. KJV: heat.

καυματιζω.def: from καῦμα (G2738); to burn. KJV: scorch.

καυσισ.def: from καίω (G2545); burning (the act). KJV: be burned.

καυσοω.def: from καῦσις (G2740); to set on fire. KJV: fervent heat.

καυσων.def: from καυσόω (G2741); a glare. KJV: (burning) heat.

καυτηριαζω.def: from a derivative of καίω (G2545); to brand ("cauterize"), i.e. (by implication) to render unsensitive (figuratively). KJV: sear with a hot iron.

καυχαομαι.def: from some (obsolete) base akin to that of αὐχέω (to boast) and εὔχομαι (G2172); to vaunt (in a good or a bad sense). KJV: (make) boast, glory, joy, rejoice.

καυχημα.def: from καυχάομαι (G2744); a boast (properly, the object; by implication, the act) in a good or a bad sense. KJV: boasting, (whereof) to glory (of), glorying, rejoice(-ing).

καυχησισ.def: from καυχάομαι (G2744); boasting (properly, the act; by implication, the object), in a good or a bad sense. KJV: boasting, whereof I may glory, glorying, rejoicing.

κεγχρεαι.def: probably from kegchros (millet); Cenchreæ, a port of Corinth. KJV: Cencrea.

κεδρων.def: of Hebrew origin (H6939); Cedron (i.e. Kidron), a brook near Jerusalem. KJV: Cedron.

κειμαι.def: middle voice of a primary verb; to lie outstretched (literally or figuratively). KJV: be (appointed, laid up, made, set), lay, lie.

κειρια.def: of uncertain affinity; a swathe, i.e. winding-sheet. KJV: graveclothes.

κειρω.def: a primary verb; to shear. KJV: shear(-er).

κελευμα.def: from κελεύω (G2753); a cry of incitement. KJV: shout.

κελευω.def: from a primary κέλλω (to urge on); "hail"; to incite by word, i.e. order. KJV: bid, (at, give) command(-ment).

κενοδοξια.def: from κενόδοξος (G2755); empty glorying, i.e. self-conceit. KJV: vain-glory.

κενοδοξοσ.def: from κενός (G2756) and δόξα (G1391); vainly glorifying, i.e. self-conceited. KJV: desirous of vain-glory.

κενοσ.def: apparently a primary word; empty (literally or figuratively). KJV: empty, (in) vain.

κενοφωνια.def: from a presumed compound of κενός (G2756) and φωνή (G5456); empty sounding, i.e. fruitless discussion. KJV: vain.

κενοω.def: from κενός (G2756); to make empty, i.e. (figuratively) to abase, neutralize, falsify. KJV: make (of none effect, of no reputation, void), be in vain.

κεντρον.def: from κεντέω (to prick); a point ("centre"), i.e. a sting (figuratively, poison) or goad (figuratively, divine impulse). KJV: prick, sting.

κεντυριων.def: of Latin origin; a centurion, i.e. captain of one hundred soldiers. KJV: centurion.

κενωσ.def: adverb from κενός (G2756); vainly, i.e. to no purpose. KJV: in vain.

κεραια.def: feminine of a presumed derivative of the base of κέρας (G2768); something horn-like, i.e. (specially) the apex of a Hebrew letter (figuratively, the least particle). KJV: tittle.

κεραμευσ.def: from κέραμος (G2766); a potter. KJV: potter.

κεραμικοσ.def: from κέραμος (G2766); made of clay, i.e. earthen. KJV: of a potter.

κεραμιον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of κέραμος (G2766); an earthenware vessel, i.e. jar. KJV: pitcher.

κεραμοσ.def: probably from the base of κεράννυμι (G2767) (through the idea of mixing clay and water); earthenware, i.e. a tile (by analogy, a thin roof or awning). KJV: tiling.

κεραννυμι.def: prolonged form of a more primary κεράω (which is used in certain tenses); to mingle, i.e. (by implication) to pour out (for drinking). KJV: fill, pour out.

κερασ.def: from a primary κάρ (the hair of the head); a horn (literally or figuratively). KJV: horn.

κερατιον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of κέρας (G2768); something horned, i.e. (specially) the pod of the carob-tree. KJV: husk.

κερδαινω.def: from κέρδος (G2771); to gain (literally or figuratively). KJV: (get) gain, win.

κερδοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; gain (pecuniary or genitive case). KJV: gain, lucre.

κερμα.def: from κείρω (G2751); a clipping (bit), i.e. (specially) a coin. KJV: money.

κερματιστησ.def: from a derivative of κέρμα (G2772); a handler of coins, i.e. money-broker. KJV: changer of money.

κεφαλαιον.def: neuter of a derivative of κεφαλή (G2776); a principal thing, i.e. main point; specially, an amount (of money). KJV: sum.

κεφαλαιοω.def: from the same as κεφάλαιον (G2774); (specially) to strike on the head. KJV: wound in the head.

κεφαλη.def: from the primary κάπτω (in the sense of seizing); the head (as the part most readily taken hold of), literally or figuratively. KJV: head.

κεφαλισ.def: from κεφαλή (G2776); properly, a knob, i.e. (by implication) a roll (by extension from the end of a stick on which the manuscript was rolled). KJV: volume.

κηνσοσ.def: of Latin origin; properly, an enrollment ("census"), i.e. (by implication) a tax. KJV: tribute.

κηποσ.def: of uncertain affinity; a garden. KJV: garden.

κηπουροσ.def: from κῆπος (G2779) and οὖρος (a warden); a garden-keeper, i.e. gardener. KJV: gardener.

κηριον.def: diminutive from κηός (wax); a cell for honey, i.e. (collectively) the comb. KJV: (honey-)comb.

κηρυγμα.def: from κηρύσσω (G2784); a proclamation (especially of the gospel; by implication, the gospel itself). KJV: preaching.

κηρυξ.def: from κηρύσσω (G2784); a herald, i.e. of divine truth (especially of the gospel). KJV: preacher.

κηρυσσω.def: of uncertain affinity; to herald (as a public crier), especially divine truth (the gospel). KJV: preacher(-er), proclaim, publish.

κητοσ.def: probably from the base of χάσμα (G5490); a huge fish (as gaping for prey). KJV: whale.

κηφασ.def: of Chaldee origin (compare H3710); the Rock; Cephas (i.e. Kepha), a surname of Peter. KJV: Cephas.

κιβωτοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; a box, i.e. the sacred ark and that of Noah. KJV: ark.

κιθαρα.def: of uncertain affinity; a lyre. KJV: harp.

κιθαριζω.def: from κιθάρα (G2788); to play on a lyre. KJV: harp.

κιθαρωδοσ.def: from κιθάρα (G2788) and a derivative of the same as ᾠδή (G5603); a lyre-singer(-player), i.e. harpist. KJV: harper.

κιλικια.def: probably of foreign origin; Cilicia, a region of Asia Minor. KJV: Cilicia.

κιναμωμον.def: of foreign origin (compare H7076); cinnamon. KJV: cinnamon.

κινδυνευω.def: from κίνδυνος (G2794); to undergo peril. KJV: be in danger, be (stand) in jeopardy.

κινδυνοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; danger. KJV: peril.

κινεω.def: from κίω (poetic for εἶμι, to go); to stir (transitively), literally or figuratively. KJV: (re-)move(-r), way.

κινησισ.def: from κινέω (G2795); a stirring. KJV: moving.

κισ.def: of Hebrew origin (H7027); Cis (i.e. Kish), an Israelite. KJV: Cis.

κλαδοσ.def: from κλάω (G2806); a twig or bough (as if broken off). KJV: branch.

κλαιω.def: of uncertain affinity; to sob, i.e. wail aloud (whereas 1145 is rather to cry silently). KJV: bewail, weep.

κλασισ.def: from κλάω (G2806); fracture (the act). KJV: breaking.

κλασμα.def: from κλάω (G2806); a piece (bit). KJV: broken, fragment.

κλαυδη.def: of uncertain derivation; Claude, an island near Crete. KJV: Clauda.

κλαυδια.def: feminine of Κλαύδιος (G2804); Claudia, a Christian woman. KJV: Claudia.

κλαυδιοσ.def: of Latin origin; Claudius, the name of two Romans. KJV: Claudius.

κλαυθμοσ.def: from κλαίω (G2799); lamentation. KJV: wailing, weeping, X wept.

κλαω.def: a primary verb; to break (specially, of bread). KJV: break.

κλεισ.def: from κλείω (G2808); a key (as shutting a lock), literally or figuratively. KJV: key.

κλειω.def: a primary verb; to close (literally or figuratively). KJV: shut (up).

κλεμμα.def: from κλέπτω (G2813); stealing (properly, the thing stolen, but used of the act). KJV: theft.

κλεοπασ.def: probably contracted from Κλεόπατρος (compound of κλέος (G2811) and πατήρ (G3962)); Cleopas, a Christian. KJV: Cleopas.

κλεοσ.def: from a shorter form of καλέω (G2564); renown (as if being called). KJV: glory.

κλεπτησ.def: from κλέπτω (G2813); a stealer (literally or figuratively). KJV: thief.

κλεπτω.def: a primary verb; to filch. KJV: steal.

κλημα.def: from κλάω (G2806); a limb or shoot (as if broken off). KJV: branch.

κλημησ.def: of Latin origin; merciful; Clemes (i.e. Clemens), a Christian. KJV: Clement.

κληρονομεω.def: from κληρονόμος (G2818); to be an heir to (literally or figuratively). KJV: be heir, (obtain by) inherit(-ance).

κληρονομια.def: from κληρονόμος (G2818); heirship, i.e. (concretely) a patrimony or (genitive case) a possession. KJV: inheritance.

κληρονομοσ.def: from κλῆρος (G2819) and the base of νόμος (G3551) (in its original sense of partitioning, i.e. (reflexively) getting by apportionment); a sharer by lot, i.e. inheritor (literally or figuratively); by implication, a possessor. KJV: heir.

κληροσ.def: probably from κλάω (G2806) (through the idea of using bits of wood, etc., for the purpose; a die (for drawing chances); by implication, a portion (as if so secured); by extension, an acquisition (especially a patrimony, figuratively). KJV: heritage, inheritance, lot, part.

κληροω.def: from κλῆρος (G2819); to allot, i.e. (figuratively) to assign (a privilege). KJV: obtain an inheritance.

κλησισ.def: from a shorter form of καλέω (G2564); an invitation (figuratively). KJV: calling.

κλητοσ.def: from the same as κλῆσις (G2821); invited, i.e. appointed, or (specially), a saint. KJV: called.

κλιβανοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; an earthen pot used for baking in. KJV: oven.

κλιμα.def: from κλίνω (G2827); a slope, i.e. (specially) a "clime" or tract of country. KJV: part, region.

κλινη.def: from κλίνω (G2827); a couch (for sleep, sickness, sitting or eating). KJV: bed, table.

κλινιδιον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of κλίνη (G2825); a pallet or little couch. KJV: bed.

κλινω.def: a primary verb; to slant or slope, i.e. incline or recline (literally or figuratively). KJV: bow (down), be far spent, lay, turn to flight, wear away.

κλισια.def: from a derivative of κλίνω (G2827); properly, reclination, i.e. (concretely and specially), a party at a meal. KJV: company.

κλυδων.def: from κλύζω (to billow or dash over); a surge of the sea (literally or figuratively). KJV: raging, wave.

κλυδωνιζομαι.def: middle voice from κλύδων (G2830); to surge, i.e. (figuratively) to fluctuate. KJV: toss to and fro.

κλωπασ.def: of Chaldee origin (corresponding to H256); Clopas, an Israelite. KJV: Cleophas.

κνηθω.def: from a primary κνάω (to scrape); to scratch, i.e. (by implication) to tickle. KJV: X itching.

κνιδοσ.def: probably of foreign origin; Cnidus, a place in Asia Minor. KJV: Cnidus.

κοδραντησ.def: of Latin origin; a quadrans, i.e. the fourth part of an as. KJV: farthing.

κοιλια.def: from κοῖλος ("hollow"); a cavity, i.e. (especially) the abdomen; by implication, the matrix; figuratively, the heart. KJV: belly, womb.

κοιμαω.def: from κεῖμαι (G2749); to put to sleep, i.e. (passively or reflexively) to slumber; figuratively, to decease. KJV: (be a-, fall a-, fall on) sleep, be dead.

κοιμησισ.def: from κοιμάω (G2837); sleeping, i.e. (by implication) repose. KJV: taking of rest.

κοινοσ.def: probably from σύν (G4862); common, i.e. (literally) shared by all or several, or (ceremonially) profane. KJV: common, defiled, unclean, unholy.

κοινοω.def: from κοινός (G2839); to make (or consider) profane (ceremonially). KJV: call common, defile, pollute, unclean.

κοινωνεω.def: from κοινωνός (G2844); to share with others (objectively or subjectively). KJV: communicate, distribute, be partaker.

κοινωνια.def: from κοινωνός (G2844); partnership, i.e. (literally) participation, or (social) intercourse, or (pecuniary) benefaction. KJV: (to) communicate(-ation), communion, (contri-)distribution, fellowship.

κοινωνικοσ.def: from κοινωνός (G2844); communicative, i.e. (pecuniarily) liberal. KJV: willing to communicate.

κοινωνοσ.def: from κοινός (G2839); a sharer, i.e. associate. KJV: companion, X fellowship, partaker, partner.

κοιτη.def: from κεῖμαι (G2749); a couch; by extension, cohabitation; by implication, the male sperm. KJV: bed, chambering, X conceive.

κοιτων.def: from κοίτη (G2845); a bedroom. KJV: + chamberlain.

κοκκινοσ.def: from κόκκος (G2848) (from the kernel-shape of the insect); crimson-colored. KJV: scarlet (colour, coloured).

κοκκοσ.def: apparently a primary word; a kernel of seed. KJV: corn, grain.

κολαζω.def: from κόλος (dwarf); properly, to curtail, i.e. (figuratively) to chastise (or reserve for infliction). KJV: punish.

κολακεια.def: from a derivative of κόλαξ (a fawner); flattery. KJV: X flattering.

κολασισ.def: from κολάζω (G2849); penal infliction. KJV: punishment, torment.

κολαφιζω.def: from a derivative of the base of κολάζω (G2849); to rap with the fist. KJV: buffet.

κολλαω.def: from κόλλα ("glue"); to glue, i.e. (passively or reflexively) to stick (figuratively). KJV: cleave, join (self), keep company.

κολλουριον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of κολλύρα (a cake; prob akin to the base of κολλάω (G2853)); properly, a poultice (as made of or in the form of crackers), i.e. (by analogy) a plaster. KJV: eyesalve.

κολλυβιστησ.def: from a presumed derivative of κόλλυβος (a small coin; probably akin to κολλούριον (G2854)); a coin-dealer. KJV: (money-)changer.

κολοβοω.def: from a derivative of the base of κολάζω (G2849); to dock, i.e. (figuratively) abridge. KJV: shorten.

κολοσσαευσ.def: from Κολοσσαί (G2857); a Colossæan, (i.e. inhabitant of Colossæ. KJV: Colossian.

κολοσσαι.def: apparently feminine plural of kolossos ("colossal"); Colossæ, a place in Asia Minor. KJV: Colosse.

κολποσ.def: apparently a primary word; the bosom; by analogy, a bay. KJV: bosom, creek.

κολυμβαω.def: from κόλυμβος (a diver); to plunge into water. KJV: swim.

κολυμβηθρα.def: from κολυμβάω (G2860); a diving-place, i.e. pond for bathing (or swimming). KJV: pool.

κολωνια.def: of Latin origin; a Roman "colony" for veterans. KJV: colony.

κομαω.def: from κόμη (G2864); to wear tresses of hair. KJV: have long hair.

κομη.def: apparently from the same as κομίζω (G2865); the hair of the head (locks, as ornamental, and thus differing from θρίξ (G2359); which properly denotes merely the scalp). KJV: hair.

κομιζω.def: from a primary κομέω (to tend, i.e. take care of); properly, to provide for, i.e. (by implication) to carry off (as if from harm; genitive case obtain). KJV: bring, receive.

κομψοτερον.def: neuter comparative of a derivative of the base of 2865 (meaning, properly, well dressed, i.e. nice); figuratively, convalescent. KJV: + began to amend.

κονιαω.def: from κονία (dust; by analogy, lime); to whitewash. KJV: whiten.

κονιορτοσ.def: from the base of κονιάω (G2867) and ornumi (to "rouse"); pulverulence (as blown about). KJV: dust.

κοπαζω.def: from κόπος (G2873); to tire, i.e. (figuratively) to relax. KJV: cease.

κοπετοσ.def: from κόπτω (G2875); mourning (properly, by beating the breast). KJV: lamentation.

κοπη.def: from κόπτω (G2875); cutting, i.e. carnage. KJV: slaughter.

κοπιαω.def: from a derivative of κόπος (G2873); to feel fatigue; by implication, to work hard. KJV: (bestow) labour, toil, be wearied.

κοποσ.def: from κόπτω (G2875); a cut, i.e. (by analogy) toil (as reducing the strength), literally or figuratively; by implication, pains. KJV: labour, + trouble, weariness.

κοπρια.def: from κόπρος (ordure; perhaps akin to κόπτω (G2875)); manure. KJV: dung(-hill).

κοπτω.def: a primary verb; to "chop"; specially, to beat the breast in grief. KJV: cut down, lament, mourn, (be-)wail.

κοραξ.def: perhaps from κορέννυμι (G2880); a crow (from its voracity). KJV: raven.

κορασιον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of κόρη (a maiden); a (little) girl. KJV: damsel, maid.

κορβαν.def: of Hebrew and Chaldee origin respectively (H7133); a votive offering and the offering; a consecrated present (to the Temple fund); by extension (the latter term) the Treasury itself, i.e. the room where the contribution boxes stood. KJV: Corban, treasury.

κορε.def: of Hebrew origin (H7141); Core (i.e. Korach), an Israelite. KJV: Core.

κορεννυμι.def: a primary verb; to cram, i.e. glut or sate. KJV: eat enough, full.

κορινθιοσ.def: from Κόρινθος (G2882); a Corinthian, i.e. inhabitant of Corinth. KJV: Corinthian.

κορινθοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; Corinthus, a city of Greece. KJV: Corinth.

κορνηλιοσ.def: of Latin origin; Cornelius, a Roman. KJV: Cornelius.

κοροσ.def: of Hebrew origin (H3734); a cor, i.e. a specific measure. KJV: measure.

κοσμεω.def: from κόσμος (G2889); to put in proper order, i.e. decorate (literally or figuratively); specially, to snuff (a wick). KJV: adorn, garnish, trim.

κοσμικοσ.def: from κόσμος (G2889) (in its secondary sense); terrene ("cosmic"), literally (mundane) or figuratively (corrupt). KJV: worldly.

κοσμιοσ.def: from κόσμος (G2889) (in its primary sense); orderly, i.e. decorous. KJV: of good behaviour, modest.

κοσμοκρατωρ.def: from κόσμος (G2889) and κρατέω (G2902); a world-ruler, an epithet of Satan. KJV: ruler.

κοσμοσ.def: probably from the base of κομίζω (G2865); orderly arrangement, i.e. decoration; by implication, the world (in a wide or narrow sense, including its inhabitants, literally or figuratively (morally)). KJV: adorning, world.

κουαρτοσ.def: of Latin origin (fourth); Quartus, a Christian. KJV: Quartus.

κουμι.def: of Chaldee origin (H6966); cumi (i.e. rise!). KJV: cumi.

κουστωδια.def: of Latin origin; "custody", i.e. a Roman sentry. KJV: watch.

κουφιζω.def: from κοῦφος (light in weight); to unload. KJV: lighten.

κοφινοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; a (small) basket. KJV: basket.

κραββατοσ.def: probably of foreign origin; a mattress. KJV: bed.

κραζω.def: a primary verb; properly, to "croak" (as a raven) or scream, i.e. (genitive case) to call aloud (shriek, exclaim, intreat). KJV: cry (out).

κραιπαλη.def: probably from the same as ἁρπάζω (G726); properly, a headache (as a seizure of pain) from drunkenness, i.e. (by implication) a debauch (by analogy, a glut). KJV: surfeiting.

κρανιον.def: diminutive of a derivative of the base of κέρας (G2768); a skull ("cranium"). KJV: Calvary, skull.

κρασπεδον.def: of uncertain derivation; a margin, i.e. (specially), a fringe or tassel. KJV: border, hem.

κραταιοω.def: from κραταιός (G2900); to empower, i.e. (passively) increase in vigor. KJV: be strengthened, be (wax) strong.

κρατεω.def: from κράτος (G2904); to use strength, i.e. seize or retain (literally or figuratively). KJV: hold (by, fast), keep, lay hand (hold) on, obtain, retain, take (by).

κρατιστοσ.def: superlative of a derivative of κράτος (G2904); strongest, i.e. (in dignity) very honorable. KJV: most excellent (noble).

κρατοσ.def: perhaps a primary word; vigor ("great") (literally or figuratively). KJV: dominion, might(-ily), power, strength.

κραυγαζω.def: from κραυγή (G2906); to clamor. KJV: cry out.

κραυγη.def: from κράζω (G2896); an outcry (in notification, tumult or grief). KJV: clamour, cry(-ing).

κρεασ.def: perhaps a primary word; (butcher's) meat. KJV: flesh.

κρεισσον.def: neuter of an alternate form of κρείττων (G2909); (as noun) better, i.e. greater advantage. KJV: better.

κρειττων.def: comparative of a derivative of κράτος (G2904); stronger, i.e. (figuratively) better, i.e. nobler. KJV: best, better.

κρεμαννυμι.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb; to hang. KJV: hang.

κρημνοσ.def: from κρεμάννυμι (G2910); overhanging, i.e. a precipice. KJV: steep place.

κρησ.def: from Κρήτη (G2914); a Cretan, i.e. inhabitant of Crete. KJV: Crete, Cretian.

κρησκησ.def: of Latin origin; growing; Cresces (i.e. Crescens), a Christian. KJV: Crescens.

κρητη.def: of uncertain derivation; Crete, an island in the Mediterranean. KJV: Crete.

κριθη.def: of uncertain derivation; barley. KJV: barley.

κριθινοσ.def: from κριθή (G2915); consisting of barley. KJV: barley.

κριμα.def: from κρίνω (G2919); a decision (the function or the effect, for or against ("crime")). KJV: avenge, condemned, condemnation, damnation, + go to law, judgment.

κρινον.def: perhaps a prim word; a lily. KJV: lily.

κρινω.def: properly, to distinguish, i.e. decide (mentally or judicially); by implication, to try, condemn, punish. KJV: avenge, conclude, condemn, damn, decree, determine, esteem, judge, go to (sue at the) law, ordain, call in question, sentence to, think.

κρισισ.def: decision (subjectively or objectively, for or against); by extension, a tribunal; by implication, justice (especially, divine law). KJV: accusation, condemnation, damnation, judgment.

κρισποσ.def: of Latin origin; "crisp"; Crispus, a Corinthian. KJV: Crispus.

κριτηριον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of κριτής (G2923); a rule of judging ("criterion"), i.e. (by implication) a tribunal. KJV: to judge, judgment (seat).

κριτησ.def: from κρίνω (G2919); a judge (genitive case or specially). KJV: judge.

κριτικοσ.def: from κριτής (G2923); decisive ("critical"), i.e. discriminative. KJV: discerner.

κρουω.def: apparently a primary verb; to rap. KJV: knock.

κρυπτη.def: feminine of κρυπτός (G2927); a hidden place, i.e. cellar ("crypt"). KJV: secret.

κρυπτοσ.def: from κρύπτω (G2928); concealed, i.e. private. KJV: hid(-den), inward(-ly), secret.

κρυπτω.def: a primary verb; to conceal (properly, by covering). KJV: hide (self), keep secret, secret(-ly).

κρυσταλλιζω.def: from κρύσταλλος (G2930); to make (i.e. intransitively, resemble) ice ("crystallize"). KJV: be clear as crystal.

κρυσταλλοσ.def: from a derivative of κρύος (frost); ice, i.e. (by analogy) rock "crystal". KJV: crystal.

κρυφη.def: adverb from κρύπτω (G2928); privately. KJV: in secret.

κταομαι.def: a primary verb; to get, i.e. acquire (by any means; own). KJV: obtain, possess, provide, purchase.

κτημα.def: from κτάομαι (G2932); an acquirement, i.e. estate. KJV: possession.

κτηνοσ.def: from κτάομαι (G2932); property, i.e. (specially) a domestic animal. KJV: beast.

κτητωρ.def: from κτάομαι (G2932); an owner. KJV: possessor.

κτιζω.def: probably akin to κτάομαι (G2932) (through the idea of proprietorship of the manufacturer); to fabricate, i.e. found (form originally). KJV: create, Creator, make.

κτισισ.def: from κτίζω (G2936); original formation (properly, the act; by implication, the thing, literally or figuratively). KJV: building, creation, creature, ordinance.

κτισμα.def: from κτίζω (G2936); an original formation (concretely), i.e. product (created thing). KJV: creature.

κτιστησ.def: from κτίζω (G2936); a founder, i.e. God (as author of all things). KJV: Creator.

κυβεια.def: from κύβος (a "cube", i.e. die for playing); gambling, i.e. (figuratively) artifice or fraud. KJV: sleight.

κυβερνησισ.def: from κυβερνάω (of Latin origin, to steer); pilotage, i.e. (figuratively) directorship (in the church). KJV: government.

κυβερνητησ.def: from the same as κυβέρνησις (G2941); helmsman, i.e. (by implication) captain. KJV: (ship) master.

κυκλοθεν.def: adverb from the same as κύκλῳ (G2945); from the circle, i.e. all around. KJV: (round) about.

κυκλοω.def: from the same as κύκλῳ (G2945); to encircle, i.e. surround. KJV: compass (about), come (stand) round about.

κυκλω.def: as if dative case of κύκλος (a ring, "cycle"; akin to κυλιόω (G2947)); i.e. in a circle (by implication, of ἐν (G1722)), i.e. (adverbially) all around. KJV: round about.

κυλιοω.def: from the base of κῦμα (G2949) (through the idea of circularity; compare κύκλῳ (G2945), εἱλίσσω (G1507)); to roll about. KJV: wallow.

κυλισμα.def: from κυλιόω (G2947); a wallow (the effect of rolling), i.e. filth. KJV: wallowing.

κυλλοσ.def: from the same as κυλιόω (G2947); rocking about, i.e. crippled (maimed, in feet or hands). KJV: maimed.

κυμα.def: from κύω (to swell (with young), i.e. bend, curve); a billow (as bursting or toppling). KJV: wave.

κυμβαλον.def: from a derivative of the base of κῦμα (G2949); a "cymbal" (as hollow). KJV: cymbal.

κυμινον.def: of foreign origin (compare H3646); dill or fennel ("cummin"). KJV: cummin.

κυναριον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of κύων (G2965); a puppy. KJV: dog.

κυπριοσ.def: from Κύπρος (G2954); a Cyprian (Cypriot), i.e. inhabitant of Cyprus. KJV: of Cyprus.

κυπροσ.def: of uncertain origin; Cyprus, an island in the Mediterranean. KJV: Cyprus.

κυπτω.def: probably from the base of κῦμα (G2949); to bend forward. KJV: stoop (down).

κυρηναιοσ.def: from Κυρήνη (G2957); i.e. Cyrenæan, i.e. inhabitant of Cyrene. KJV: of Cyrene, Cyrenian.

κυρηνη.def: of uncertain derivation; Cyrene, a region of Africa. KJV: Cyrene.

κυρηνιοσ.def: of Latin origin; Cyrenius (i.e. Quirinus), a Roman. KJV: Cyrenius.

κυρια.def: feminine of κύριος (G2962); Cyria, a Christian woman. KJV: lady.

κυριακοσ.def: from κύριος (G2962); belonging to the Lord (Jehovah or Jesus). KJV: Lord's.

κυριευω.def: from κύριος (G2962); to rule. KJV: have dominion over, lord, be lord of, exercise lordship over.

κυριοσ.def: from κῦρος (supremacy); supreme in authority, i.e. (as noun) controller; by implication, Master (as a respectful title). KJV: God, Lord, master, Sir.

κυριοτησ.def: from κύριος (G2962); mastery, i.e. (concretely and collectively) rulers. KJV: dominion, government.

κυροω.def: from the same as κύριος (G2962); to make authoritative, i.e. ratify. KJV: confirm.

κυων.def: a primary word; a dog ("hound") (literally or figuratively). KJV: dog.

κωλον.def: from the base of κολάζω (G2849); a limb of the body (as if lopped). KJV: carcase.

κωλυω.def: from the base of κολάζω (G2849); to estop, i.e. prevent (by word or act). KJV: forbid, hinder, keep from, let, not suffer, withstand.

κωμη.def: from κεῖμαι (G2749); a hamlet (as if laid down). KJV: town, village.

κωμοπολισ.def: from κώμη (G2968) and πόλις (G4172); an unwalled city. KJV: town.

κωμοσ.def: from κεῖμαι (G2749); a carousal (as if letting loose). KJV: revelling, rioting.

κωνωψ.def: apparently a derivative of the base of κέντρον (G2759) and a derivative of ὀπτάνομαι (G3700); a mosquito (from its stinging proboscis). KJV: gnat.

κωσ.def: of uncertain origin; Cos, an island in the Mediterranean. KJV: Cos.

κωσαμ.def: of Hebrew origin (compare H7081); Cosam (i.e. Kosam) an Israelite. KJV: Cosam.

κωφοσ.def: from κόπτω (G2875); blunted, i.e. (figuratively) of hearing (deaf) or speech (dumb). KJV: deaf, dumb, speechless.
